seo.title: AQUASKY FAQ: Diaphragm Pressure Tank Warranty, MOQ & Customization
seo.description: Find answers to common questions about AQUASKY pressure tanks, including our 3/5-year warranty, B2B MOQ (one 20ft container), and NSF/ANSI 372 lead-free certification.

h1: AQUASKY FAQ: Diaphragm Pressure Tank Warranty, MOQ & Customization
subtitle: CERTIFICATION

mainEntity.name: Are AQUASKY pressure tanks marked "CE"?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, AQUASKY pressure tanks are complied with the European PED Directive 2014/68 / EU (Pressure Equipment Directive) and according to EN 13831.

mainEntity.name: What is NSF 61?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generally speaking, the Standard is about the specific materials that come into contact with any type of drinking water. This standard concentrates on evaluating contaminants or impurities imparted into drinking water, and has established the health requirements of the water.

mainEntity.name: Can the products be provided with complete material traceability and certification documents (e.g., NSF, CE, WRAS)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Products comply with major certifications including NSF/ANSI 58, 61, 372, CE, ACS, KC, WaterMark, and UPC. All wet part materials are in line with EU RoHS and REACH, and also comply with PFAS and TSCA requirements. Each product is manufactured under strict ISO 9001 quality management systems, allowing full traceability of materials and processes.

mainEntity.name: What are AQUASKY's practices regarding ESG?

acceptedAnswer.text: Environment: ISO 14064-1:2018 certified carbon verification and GHG inventory; Use of eco-friendly triple-layer coatings. Social: Daily tracking of incident rates; employee safety is our top priority. No child labor or forced labor. Governance: Transparent operations and stable financial management; ISO 9001 certified quality management system.

mainEntity.name: Is AQUASKY a manufacturer or a trading company?

acceptedAnswer.text: AQUASKY is a 100% manufacturer based in Taichung, Taiwan. All critical processes are performed in-house, including welding, coating, pressure testing, assembly, and packaging. Our facilities operate under ISO 9001 quality management systems.

mainEntity.name: Are AQUASKY diaphragm pressure tanks suitable for use with drinking water?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, AQUASKY diaphragm pressure tanks can be used in a sanitary water circuit and can come in contact with drinking water.

mainEntity.name: What is the maximum working pressure of AQUASKY pressure tanks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pressure Tanks Bar PSI Pumplus 10 150 Mega-Plus 16 232 Giga-Plus 25 362 RO-Plus 7 100 Thermal-Plus 10 150 Solar-Plus 10 150 Hydro-Plus 10 150 LQCOL-Plus 10 150

mainEntity.name: What is the maximum working temperature of AQUASKY pressure tanks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pressure Tanks °C °F Pumplus 90 194 Mega-Plus 90 194 Giga-Plus 90 194 RO-Plus 90 194 Thermal-Plus 90 194 LQCOL-Plus 120 248 Solar-Plus 130 266 Hydro-Plus 130 266

mainEntity.name: What is the warranty on AQUASKY pressure tanks?

acceptedAnswer.text: AQUASKY warranty differs in market. Please contact your local distributor for warranty applicable in your area.

mainEntity.name: Please detail your R&D and design capabilities for OEM/ODM projects.

acceptedAnswer.text: Advanced 3D CAD modeling & pressure simulation: Our engineering team uses full 3D CAD design and simulates internal pressure performance. Rapid prototyping: We transform design concepts into functional prototypes within weeks, allowing for faster testing and a shorter time to market. Flexible customization: Options in design, size, coating colors, and connection fittings.

mainEntity.name: What key manufacturing technologies or exclusive patents does AQUASKY possess?

acceptedAnswer.text: Welding excellence: Produced with PED-certified welding technologies, meeting ASME VIII Div.1 and EN 13831 standards. 100% Nitrogen pre-charge: Factory pre-charged with pure nitrogen to minimize pressure loss. Patented Leak-Safe Connector: Provides a secure, corrosion-resistant, and leak-proof system connection. Protective coatings: Multi-layer epoxy coating provides long-term rust and corrosion resistance.

mainEntity.name: What is your MOQ policy? Do you accept mixed-model orders?

acceptedAnswer.text: No required MOQ for standard colors (Blue and Almond). The MOQ for customized colors is 400 pieces per shipment. Mixed models are allowed within the same container.

mainEntity.name: Can the pre-charge pressure of AQUASKY pressure tanks be modified?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is possible to modify the pre-charge pressure of AQUASKY pressure tanks with cautions. We suggest asking to an expert to carry out the operation. Being aware of the specific features of the system or plant where the vessel has to be or is installed, the pre-charge pressure of an empty AQUASKY vessel can be increased up to a maximum of 3.5 bar and can be reduced to a minimum of 0.5 bar.

mainEntity.name: What information is required and how do you size AQUASKY pressure tanks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Depending on the type of use (for boilers, heating systems, domestic hot water systems, hot and cold water systems) it is possible to size the pressure tank by consulting the AQUASKY CALCULATOR FOR DIMENSIONING OF AQUASKY PRODUCTS. For more information, contact our technical department.

mainEntity.name: How does the pressure switch control the pump and tank?

acceptedAnswer.text: The pressure switch is the coordinator between the tanks and the pump. The pressure switch monitors the pressure inside the tank. Accordingly, turns on or shuts down the pump when cut-in and cut-out pressures have reached inside the tank, separately.

mainEntity.name: What are usual cut-ins and cut-outs?

acceptedAnswer.text: In general, pump starts and stops according to the pre-established pressure settings. Our pressure tank's drawdown feature with a 30/50 pressure setting. This means that the pump starts (cut-in) when the tank psi is 30 and will stop (cut-out) at 50psi. There is often a 20psi difference between the cut-in and out, starting at 20psi.

mainEntity.name: What is the usual pre-charge for a tank?

acceptedAnswer.text: The pre-charge of a tank depends on many factors. First of all, what type of tank (generally speaking, purely heating or potable water usage) and how big the tank is. All AQUASKY tanks are pre-charged and tested in the factory. The pre-charge should be 2psi less than the pump cut-in pressure.

mainEntity.name: In your QC process, what are the standards for pressure cycle testing?

acceptedAnswer.text: All tanks are tested in compliance with NSF/ANSI 61 and EU PED standards. Each unit undergoes 100,000 continuous pressure cycles between pre-charge and maximum working pressure to ensure long-term performance.

mainEntity.name: How can I install, service and mantain the pressure tanks manufactured by AQUASKY?

acceptedAnswer.text: As regard to the installation, service and maintenance of pressure tanks manufactured by AQUASKY, please refer to the instruction manuals.

mainEntity.name: How do you handle customization requests and technical integration with a client's existing systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Provide mixed-model samples for testing. Engineering team works jointly with clients to adapt capacity, fittings, and pressure ranges. Technical drawings and simulation data are supplied for smooth system integration.

mainEntity.name: Why a diaphragm tank?

acceptedAnswer.text: A diaphragm tank allows the system N2 cushion to be separated from the system water. This prevents water from leaking since the N2 is between the tank wall and the outside of the diaphragm and the system water is on the other side. The AQUASKY pressure tank shell has an epoxy powder coated food grade material, furthermore, this family of tanks is NSF 61 approved.

mainEntity.name: Why use nitrogen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nitrogen is less likely to migrate through diaphragm rubber than is oxygen, which means the pressure tank does not need to re-fill the air pressure once on the pressure tank in service. Nitrogen is a very stable gas against with temperature changes which means more consistent inflation pressures during the service life.

mainEntity.name: How can you check if the internal diaphragm of a pressure tank is broken?

acceptedAnswer.text: All AQUASKY pressure tanks with diaphragm are pre-charged with N2 through an air valve. The rubber diaphragm inside the tank keeps the water separated from the N2. Therefore, in case of malfunction and to check if the diaphragm of the tank is broken, you must act on the internal mechanism of the air valve, pressing it with a tool such as a screwdriver, and checking what comes out. If water leaks, it means the membrane is broken and the water has completely filled the vessel. Whereas, if air comes out, the membrane should still be intact and it is necessary to simply pre-charge the pressure tank again to make it work.

mainEntity.name: How to avoid damages and malfunctions in pressure tanks and ensure lifetime to the installed product?

acceptedAnswer.text: In order to avoid breakages and malfunctions, consult the technical label which stuck to the pressure tank and the instruction manual supplied by the manufacturer first. Moreover, it is necessary to: ● Install correctly and periodic maintenance ● Periodically check the pre-charge pressure of the pressure tank and if necessary restore it to the value indicated on the label ● Check the correct grounding of the system, so as to avoid galvanic currents ● Check the correct volume of the pressure tank ● Pay attention to excessive overpressure and water hammering phenomena in the system ● Avoid to install the pressure tank in unsuitable environments or areas subjected to particularly aggressive climatic conditions ● Avoid the formation of condensation that leads to the development of corrosive phenomena ● Monitor the pH value of solutions containing glycols or other substances ● Avoid mixing different antifreeze products

mainEntity.name: Why should we choose AQUASKY as our long-term strategic partner?

acceptedAnswer.text: AQUASKY is a leading manufacturer with sales in over 50 countries. We combine high production reliability, flexible OEM/ODM capabilities, and stable pricing to support your business growth.

mainEntity.name: What is AQUASKY's company vision and five-year development roadmap?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vision: To become the most trusted global manufacturer. Roadmap: Investing in smart manufacturing, expanding into regions like Africa and Central Asia, developing eco-friendly products, and advancing ESG goals.

mainEntity.name: How does AQUASKY ensure the stability and resilience of its global supply chain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Multi-port shipping (Keelung/Taichung/Kaohsiung), diversified raw-material sourcing, and regional stock points through distribution partners to buffer shocks.

mainEntity.name: What are the terms for becoming a distributor, pricing structure, and payment terms?

acceptedAnswer.text: MOQ is one 20ft container (mixed models allowed) based on FOB Taichung terms. Payment: 100% T/T for first order; 50% deposit and 50% before shipment for subsequent orders.

mainEntity.name: What are the specific terms of the warranty and after-sales service?

acceptedAnswer.text: RO Tank: 3-years; Well/Thermal/Hydronic Tanks: 5-years. Warranty covers manufacturing defects only. Approved claims are resolved through product replacement in the customer's next order.

FAQ

CERTIFICATION

Are AQUASKY pressure tanks marked "CE"?

Yes, AQUASKY pressure tanks are complied with the European PED
Directive 2014/68 / EU (Pressure Equipment Directive) and according
to EN 13831.

What is NSF 61?
Generally speaking, the Standard is about the specific materials that come into contact with any type of drinking water. This standard concentrates on evaluating contaminants or impurities imparted into drinking water, and has established the health requirements of the water.

    • All wet part materials are in line with EU RoHS and REACH, and also comply with PFAS and TSCA requirements.

    • Each product is manufactured under strict ISO 9001 quality management systems, allowing full traceability of materials and processes.

What are AQUASKY's practices regarding ESG?

  • Environment: ISO 14064-1:2018 certified carbon verification and GHG inventory; Use of eco-friendly triple-layer coatings.

    • Social: Daily tracking of incident rates; employee safety is our top priority. No child labor or forced labor.

    • Governance: Transparent operations and stable financial management; ISO 9001 certified quality management system.

Is AQUASKY a manufacturer or a trading company?

AQUASKY is a 100% manufacturer based in Taichung, Taiwan. All critical processes are performed in-house, including welding, coating, pressure testing, assembly, and packaging. Our facilities operate under ISO 9001 quality management systems.

  • Advanced 3D CAD modeling & pressure simulation: Our engineering team uses full 3D CAD design and simulates internal pressure performance.

    • Rapid prototyping: We transform design concepts into functional prototypes within weeks, allowing for faster testing and a shorter time to market.

ADVICES

Can the pre-charge pressure of AQUASKY pressure tanks be modified?

Yes, it is possible to modify the pre-charge pressure of AQUASKY pressure tanks with cautions. We suggest asking to an expert to carry out the operation. Being aware of the specific features of the system or plant where the vessel has to be or is installed, the pre-charge pressure of an empty AQUASKY vessel can be increased up to a maximum of 3.5 bar and can be reduced to a minimum of 0.5 bar.

What information is required and how do you size AQUASKY pressure tanks?

Depending on the type of use (for boilers, heating systems, domestic hot water systems, hot and cold water systems) it is possible to size the pressure tank by consulting the AQUASKY CALCULATOR FOR DIMENSIONING OF AQUASKY PRODUCTS. For more information, contact our technical department.

PRESSURE

How does the pressure switch control the pump and tank?

The pressure switch is the coordinator between the tanks and the pump. The pressure switch monitors the pressure inside the tank. Accordingly, turns on or shuts down the pump when cut-in and cut-out pressures have reached inside the tank, separately.

What are usual cut-ins and cut-outs?

In general, pump starts and stops according to the pre-established pressure settings. Our pressure tank's drawdown feature with a 30/50 pressure setting. This means that the pump starts (cut-in) when the tank psi is 30 and will stop (cut-out) at 50psi. There is often a 20psi difference between the cut-in and out, starting at 20psi.

What is the usual pre-charge for a tank?

The pre-charge of a tank depends on many factors. First of all, what type of tank (generally speaking, purely heating or potable water usage) and how big the tank is. All AQUASKY tanks are pre-charged and tested in the factory. The pre-charge should be 2psi less than the pump cut-in pressure.

In your QC process, what are the standards for pressure cycle testing?

All tanks are tested in compliance with NSF/ANSI 61 and EU PED standards. Each unit undergoes 100,000 continuous pressure cycles between pre-charge and maximum working pressure to ensure long-term performance.

INSTALL

How can I install, service and mantain the pressure tanks manufactured by AQUASKY?

As regard to the installation, service and maintenance of pressure tanks manufactured by AQUASKY, please refer to the instruction manuals.

How do you handle customization requests and technical integration with a client's existing systems?

  • Provide mixed-model samples for testing.

    • Engineering team works jointly with clients to adapt capacity, fittings, and pressure ranges.

    • Technical drawings and simulation data are supplied for smooth system integration.

QUALITY

Why a diaphragm tank?

A diaphragm tank allows the system N2 cushion to be separated from the system water. This prevents water from leaking since the N2 is between the tank wall and the outside of the diaphragm and the system water is on the other side. The AQUASKY pressure tank shell has an epoxy powder coated food grade material, furthermore, this family of tanks is NSF 61 approved.

Why use nitrogen?

Nitrogen is less likely to migrate through diaphragm rubber than is oxygen, which means the pressure tank does not need to re-fill the air pressure once on the pressure tank in service. Nitrogen is a very stable gas against with temperature changes which means more consistent inflation pressures during the service life.

SOLUTION

How can you check if the internal diaphragm of a pressure tank is broken?

All AQUASKY pressure tanks with diaphragm are pre-charged with
N2 through an air valve. The rubber diaphragm inside the tank keeps
the water separated from the N2. Therefore, in case of malfunction
and to check if the diaphragm of the tank is broken, you must act on
the internal mechanism of the air valve, pressing it with a tool such as
a screwdriver, and checking what comes out. If water leaks, it means
the membrane is broken and the water has completely filled the
vessel. Whereas, if air comes out, the membrane should still be intact
and it is necessary to simply pre-charge the pressure tank again to
make it work.

How to avoid damages and malfunctions in pressure tanks and ensure lifetime to the installed product?

In order to avoid breakages and malfunctions, consult the technical label which stuck to the pressure tank and the instruction manual supplied by the manufacturer first. Moreover, it is necessary to:

● Install correctly and periodic maintenance

● Periodically check the pre-charge pressure of the pressure tank and if necessary restore it to the value indicated on the label

● Check the correct grounding of the system, so as to avoid galvanic currents

● Check the correct volume of the pressure tank

● Pay attention to excessive overpressure and water hammering phenomena in the system

● Avoid to install the pressure tank in unsuitable environments or areas subjected to particularly aggressive climatic conditions

● Avoid the formation of condensation that leads to the development of corrosive phenomena

● Monitor the pH value of solutions containing glycols or other substances

● Avoid mixing different antifreeze products

AQUASKY is a leading manufacturer with sales in over 50 countries. We combine high production reliability, flexible OEM/ODM capabilities, and stable pricing to support your business growth.
